name: web-rails
author: Marlon Chaviano
title: Web app with Ruby on Rails
description: Rails 8 with Hotwire, SQLite and Propshaft: a complete app (views, database, jobs) without setting up anything else.

base.command: command -v rails >/dev/null || { echo 'Rails is required: gem install rails' >&2; exit 1; }; rails new {{name}} --skip-git --skip-bundle --skip-kamal --skip-thruster

verify.command: bin/rails db:prepare && bin/rails test && bin/rails zeitwerk:check && (test ! -d spec || bundle exec rspec)

instructions:
## How to work here

- Follow Rails conventions: generate with `bin/rails generate` (models, controllers, migrations) instead of creating files by hand.
- Interactivity with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus) before reaching for a JavaScript framework.
- After changing the schema: `bin/rails db:migrate`. Before finishing: `bin/rails test`.
